tax.text: Ricketts supported the Working Families Tax Cut, which reduced or avoided federal taxes for families, seniors, and businesses.
tax.quote: The Working Families Tax Cut means 88% of seniors won’t have to pay income taxes on their Social Security benefits.

housing.text: Ricketts supported the ROAD to Housing Act and legislation intended to increase housing supply, including in rural Nebraska.
housing.quote: The ROAD to Housing Act will help our country increase housing supply,” said Ricketts.

schools.text: Ricketts supports school choice and created scholarships for families to attend the school of their choice.
schools.quote: We created scholarships for Nebraskans to attend the school of their choice.

safety.text: Ricketts supported enhanced policing tools, additional law-enforcement resources, and efforts to combat fentanyl and illegal immigration.
safety.quote: I’m backing the blue, so Nebraska law enforcement can continue their record of excellence.

sentencing.text: Ricketts supported the HALT Fentanyl Act, which he said would impose harsher sentences on fentanyl traffickers.
sentencing.quote: It will lead to harsher sentences for fentanyl traffickers and fewer overdose deaths.

immigration.text: Ricketts backs building the border wall, tightening asylum law, and stopping sanctuary cities.
immigration.quote: He supports legislation to reform our broken asylum laws and build the wall.

abortion.text: Ricketts calls himself pro-life, praised the Dobbs decision, and says work to restrict abortion continues.
abortion.quote: As we celebrate the three-year anniversary of Dobbs, we remember that our work to support life has only just begun.

energy.text: Ricketts favors expanded domestic energy production and permitting reform and opposes energy mandates.
energy.quote: America must be able to power itself. That's why Pete Ricketts believes we should be able to use our nation's natural resources responsibly.

voting.text: Ricketts supports voter ID and the SAVE Act's proof-of-citizenship requirement to vote.
voting.quote: When they claim, 'You're going to disenfranchise somebody,' well, you can look at states where we've implemented voter ID and voter-participation rates have gone up.

cannabis.text: Marvin ran as the Legal Marijuana NOW candidate with marijuana legalization as his signature issue.
cannabis.quote: Mike is committed to legal marijuana NOW — in Nebraska and across the nation.

health.text: Marvin's campaign platform included expanding Medicare and Medicaid.
health.quote: repealing the PATRIOT act, fighting against political action committee and foreign lobbying dollars in politics, and expanding Medicare and Medicaid, among others.

tax.text: Said the state should find new revenue streams and invest in education, healthcare, and public resources rather than make major spending cuts.
tax.quote: We need to invest in education, healthcare, and our citizens by finding revenue streams that don't affect our middle and lower classes.

schools.text: On a candidate questionnaire she opposed vouchers and charter schools, saying public money should not fund private education.
schools.quote: I do not support public funds paying for private education.

guns.text: She affirmed Second Amendment rights while saying she supports gun training and registration requirements.
guns.quote: I believe in the 2nd amendment but in training and registrations.

health.text: She said she supports universal health care and that the current system must change.
health.quote: I believe in universal healthcare. We have to change our current system.

tax.text: Osborn says wealthy individuals and corporations should pay their fair share while also describing himself as fiscally conservative and supporting some tax and spending cuts.
tax.quote: If paying your fair share is an increase, then I suppose yeah.

wages.text: A longtime union president who led the 2021 Kellogg's strike, he backs worker organizing and calls to ban non-compete agreements.
wages.quote: Non-compete agreements are predatory contracts that corporations force onto workers to prevent them from leaving for a better job.

schools.text: Osborn opposes private-school voucher programs because he says they divert funding from public schools.
schools.quote: I'm also against voucher programs for private schools

immigration.text: Osborn supports a secure border and removing violent criminals but opposes expanded immigration enforcement that he says has harmed American citizens.
immigration.quote: I understand and I agree with the fundamental mission of enforcement, and that's to get the criminal elements that shouldn't be here out of the country.

abortion.text: He opposes national abortion bans and supports access within Roe-era limits, while saying he opposes late-term abortions.
abortion.quote: I do not support extreme national measures to ban abortion.

cannabis.text: He supports medical cannabis, removing marijuana from Schedule I, and ending prison time for cannabis use.
cannabis.quote: Let's stop putting people in prison for cannabis use.
